title: Bus service changes
instructions: Otobüs şirketinin kısa duyurusu. Kısa ama değişen bilgilere dikkat et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: From Monday, the number twenty-four bus will not stop at the hospital.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Please take the number forty-two instead.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Buses will run every fifteen minutes, not every ten.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Tickets now cost two pounds twenty.

questions.prompt: Which bus will not stop at the hospital?
questions.feedback: Yirmi dört numaralı otobüs artık hastanede durmayacak.
questions.evidence: the number twenty-four bus will not stop at the hospital.

questions.prompt: Which bus should people take to the hospital?
questions.feedback: Bunun yerine kırk iki numaraya binilmeli. Sayılar yer değiştirmiş; dikkat.
questions.evidence: Please take the number forty-two instead.

questions.prompt: How often will the buses run?
questions.feedback: Otobüsler artık on değil, on beş dakikada bir.
questions.evidence: Buses will run every fifteen minutes, not every ten.

questions.prompt: How much is a ticket now?
questions.evidence: Tickets now cost two pounds twenty.
